answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is a slashable bond. Each agent locks collateral that is forfeited if its attestations are later proven fraudulent, so every fake identity costs real capital. Trust is carved slowly, like a canyon, from accepted outcomes rather than self-declared reputation. Like nectar gathered one flower at a time, standing accrues only through verified work. A new identity must reach the summit of a clean record before its votes carry weight.
